title: Transactions and ACID
analogy: Witch Norm casts a Midnight Transmutation Ritual (ACID). Either the enchanted gargoyle fully teleports to Crypt B, or it stays on Crypt A. It never hovers half-dissolved in the midnight fog, and never duplicates on both!
concept: A transaction groups operations into one unit. ACID: Atomicity (all or nothing), Consistency (rules stay valid), Isolation (concurrent transactions don't see each other's half-done work), Durability (committed data survives crashes).

quiz.q: A cursed potion gold is deducted but never added to the coven vault. Which property failed?
quiz.why: Atomicity means the spell manifests fully or not at all.
Once sealed in blood-red wax, the transaction survives the sunrise.
